verdict.rationale: WorkOS documents an official remote MCP server that lets MCP-compatible AI agents act on a WorkOS workspace, reading and changing the same dashboard data as the user, including organizations, connections, users and branding. A probe confirms the official MCP docs page exists. AuthKit's tooling for securing your own MCP server is a separate capability and is not credited here. Missing for 10: setup and connection instructions (client config, how the agent authenticates to the server), an enumerated tool list, and independent hands-on corroboration.
